@colibri/core.reason: Add spec-aware events, native Spec and Result exports, and supported lightweight errors/StrKey entrypoints. Reduce unnecessary registry and namespace initialization. Preserve spec error names/categories in extracted maps and surfaced matches. Add a contract-bound getLedgerEntry convenience method. Adopt ContractErrorMap as the primary error-map type name.
@colibri/core.apiReview: Additive event extraction, strict decoding and indexed filters. Preserve existing read/invoke pipelines and constructor plugin lifecycle. No additional mutable contract-error installer. Spec is the exact native SDK constructor and Result the native type; no wrappers. Granular imports share root implementations. Literal registry keys preserve stable codes; decorators, memoization and standards are unchanged. Error name/category fields are optional for existing manual maps and matches; spec/Wasm extraction populates them, and matching strategies and message behavior remain unchanged. Contract.getLedgerEntry accepts the existing key/durability shape without contractId, supplies the current bound ID and RPC, and preserves LedgerEntries.contractData defaults/results/errors. No new storage schema or codec inference; generated subclasses inherit it. ContractErrorMap replaces KnownContractErrorMap in signatures; the published old name remains a deprecated, structurally identical alias for current-major compatibility. No error matching or extraction behavior changes.

@colibri/contract-bindings.reason: Initial preview of portable typed bindings generation and a Deno CLI with JSR and npm package presets.
@colibri/contract-bindings.apiReview: New preview package. Emits constants.ts, types.ts and index.ts with spec-derived PascalCase names, named method inputs/outputs, typed generic read/invoke, errors and events using Core 1.1. Adds a contract-specific Markdown guide; no mutability inference. CLI choices use arrow-key menus; optional select callback preserves prompt-only adapters. Class-name prompts are removed in favor of filename defaults or ContractClient for remote sources. Provenance output is opt-in in CLI and programmatic generation. Generated clients import Spec and Result from Core, with no direct Stellar SDK package dependency. ContractMethods is a string enum with PascalCase members and exact ABI values; literal call names remain supported. Error metadata replaces duplicate runtime error enums; actual ABI references retain type-only numeric aliases. Generated types are grouped into methods, contract declarations, events and client configuration; generated imports use ContractErrorMap. Constants retain their layout.

@colibri/identicon.reason: Add an SVG-only public renderer and subpath sharing the existing implementation, without PNG encoding dependencies.
@colibri/identicon.apiReview: Existing Identicon methods and output remain unchanged. The new identiconSvg function uses identical validation and rendering. Core error identity is shared through its supported errors subpath.
